exclusion_reason: The ratings-site display rule is implemented as a generic resolver that shows a rating only when a reproducible recorded run backs it at the current browser profile and revision, greys it out when either pin is stale, and hides it when no backing replay exists or the run is non-deterministic. The benchmark stays red because a reproducible recorded run needs a live runtime session (BPTK-010) that does not exist, so no rating is ever in the shown state on real data.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the surface shows only record-backed rating and the stale case greys out.
active_gate_evidence: The display suite covers the shown state at a matching profile and revision, the greyed state on a stale revision or browser pin, and the hidden state for an unbacked or non-reproducible rating.
procedure: Replay the record and verify reproduction.
Expire a revision and assert the rating greys out.
